name: mcp-migration-check
description: The MCP 2026-07-28 migration skill, distributed from the repository that maintains it.

plugins.name: mcp-migration
plugins.description: Diagnose and carry out the migration of an MCP server to the 2026-07-28 specification. Runs a deterministic rule engine over the code, then walks the remediation per finding: stateless transport, OAuth 2.1, the deprecated capabilities, and the SDK v2 rename.
